title: DevOps / Kubernetes / PHP (f/m/*, 80%-100%, remote)
description:
We make politics transparent and accountable

We are PolitAnalytics, a successful Swiss civic-tech / gov-tech / legal-tech company dealing on open government data and growing rapidly at European scale. We grow and diversify our expertise in our team, we will hire a new team person, starting in October 2022 or earlier:

DevOps / k8s / PHP (f/m/*, 80%-100%, remote)
or
DevOps / k8s only (f/m/*, 40%-60%, remote)

Are you passionate about recent developments and new technologies? Are you interested in the mechanics of politics? As we share common values of diversity, we especially encourage ️‍🌈️‍anyone ️‍🌈️‍ to apply for this position.

PolitAnalytics is based on Symfony, React, and some more libraries. You will be the first devops person to join and interact with a fully agile team of back-end / front-end developers. Our tool is a comprehensive, reliable, fast, and independent platform that collects and processes open government data focusing on politics.

Your role is dedicated to long-term learning and self-developing, so you will be key in maintaining and expanding our platform. Therefore we offer competitive compensation based on your location, and additional benefits, depending on your needs and goals. We will work fully remote. Your role can be performed full time (80-100%) or part-time (40-60%) with great flexibility, we support flexible working arrangements as we are a family-friendly employer.

Your must-haves:

* Experience as a DevOps engineer in a scalable production environment.
* Setup and operate Kubernetes clusters using best practices (should know how to build architecture using the single concern principle, implement service communication, expose services outside the cluster and scale up when needed ).
* Knowledge about infrastructure monitoring and good understanding of metrics and tracking down performance issues.
* Build Docker images for production use cases.
* Excellent Linux knowledge (i.e. Alpine Linux quirks).
* Experience deploying medium sized production environments focused on limiting costs and providing high availability on GCP.
* Experience using Git for version control.
* Experience with CI/CD and automation technologies such as Ansible, Bitbucket Pipelines and/or Jenkins.
* Good PHP knowledge.
* Completed / well advanced education in computer science, programming, or applied informatics (university, technical college or similar) OR self-trained wizard with proven outstanding track record.
* Independent working habits.
* Ability to work in a team environment.
* Ability and willingness to constantly improve and learn new skills.
* Very good command of English as our main working language. We are a team of good communicators within product design, back end, front end, business.
* Based in Europe / within CET (max. ± 2h) timezone, fully able (passport, visa) to travel internationally twice a year.

Your nice-to-haves:

* Very nice to have knowledge of Symfony.
* Passion about writing clean and optimized code.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) platforms, like Terraform.
* AWS and/or other cloud providers (we currently use only google cloud but might utilize some managed services of other cloud providers)
* Experience in security monitoring
* German language skills are a plus, French and / or Italian language skills would be a super-plus.

Our hiring process follows 2-3 interviews with a personal interview, some tasks within a given amount of time, a skills assessment interview, and a final HR / contracting interview.

Please send your application (CV, cover letter, track record relevant projects) to Clemens Schuster. Don’t hesitate to ask any questions.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
huru is a health and wellness technology startup. Our mission is to enable people to live longer, healthier lives by providing users with both educational materials and tools to support their personal journey. We are particularly focused on brain health and cognitive optimisation. We are a small team that spans the disciplines of Neuroscience, Clinical Psychology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Data Science.

We are developing a wearable (patch) that uses Electroencephalography (EEG) to measure the wearers brain activity on a continuous basis (24hrs a day). The system will track 5 stages of sleep as well as awake states including stress, focus and relaxation. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to play a leading role in the research, design and development of this system. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to get hands on with data collection, data cleaning and experiment design, as well as work with existing datasets. Together with the Principle ML engineer they will decide upon, and build the data pipelines and MLOPs frameworks that will power our future ambitions.

Essential roles of function:

• Analysis and interpretation of data collected from huru's EEG sensors, accelerometers, and other biofeedback devices. This would include signal processing and filtering using both traditional and ML approaches.
• Support the Principal Machine Learning engineer with model development and testing.
• Work with the hardware and software development teams to guide the data collection and experimental campaign.
• Write production-ready Python code ready for deployment.
• Conduct literature reviews and stay apprised of recent developments.

You should apply if you have:

• Masters in Computer Science or a related field and a strong interest in a biomedical career.
• 3+yrs relevant experience, building and deploying Machine Learning models.
• Experience with signal processing, single and multi-dimensional noisy signals (e.g ECG/EEG/MEG etc.)
• Excellent programming skills in Python.
• Experience building multi-class classifiers and regressors. • Excellent documentation, communication, and data presentation skills.
• Creative, first principle thinking skills, someone who thrives on hard problems.
• A willingness to learn new methods, experiment, and take risks.

Advantageous

• Experience with feature engineering for time series signals.
• Experience with AWS S3, EC2, dynamo Db and related data infrastructure.
• Experience with google colab.
• Experience with Weight & Biases or similar experiment tracking tools. • Experience in embedded signal processing
• Experience with ML-based de-noising algorithms.
• Programming skills in software for simulation, and testing (e.g. Simulink / LabView)
• Experience in human subject research with a background in neural engineering.
• UK based

The role is 100% remote with flexible hours. Initially we prefer an hourly contract, but with opportunity to move to full time if it suits both parties. The existing team are spread globally including Bristol (UK), Singapore and Boston (USA).

Why join huru:

Work amongst fellow engineers and scientists passionate about solving some of the world's biggest problems, like how to keep our minds sharp and stay healthy as we age! Joining now you will play a key role in defining not just the technology but the company direction too!

title: Voice to Lip Synch for Educational Videos Using AI
description:
Hi everyone,

I sell educational videos that I've originally produced in English. I currently rely on subtitles when catering to non-English speaking customers, which is not ideal. I would like to create non-English versions of my videos using voiceovers produced with AI. I've solved the Text to Speech part of the puzzle, and have the voiceovers ready. The final step is synching the lips of the speakers appearing in the videos with the AI-generated audio. I want my videos to feel natural. I believe this can be accomplished with the existing deep learning technologies.

Your task will be to take the videos with coaches speaking in English and synch the lips of the speakers appearing in the videos to the new audio tracks that I've generated in other languages.

The videos are mainly (1) speakers talking in front of the white board, and (2) speakers talking into the camera. But they are not just talking heads, which makes it more complex. I try to make my videos as dynamic as possible, so I often change angles, zoom in and out to avoid boring the audience. I understand a static talking head would be easier to lip synch, but my case is a bit more complex. It's still just one person talking at a time, just a bit more dynamic.

Another complexity is beards. One of my coaches has a bushy beard. Can you work around that?

I am prepared to pay a top hourly rate to an experienced and knowledgeable person, who will get the job done, but I don't want to reinvent the wheel. I want to use existing technology. I might be prepared to invest a little into customizing the existing technology, but won't commit to creating anything from scratch. An off-the-shelf solution would be ideal. Subscription-based SAAS solutions would be fine too.

Please only respond if you know what you're doing. Can you deliver lip synching that will look natural? I don't need videos that contain artifacts and look fake.

In your response, please explain in detail how you propose to solve this problem and overcome the specific challenges I listed.

There are many "shared inbox" tools out there for Gmail, such as Drag, Gmelius, Hiver, Keeping, etc. But I am looking to create a Chrome extension that adds some basic helpdesk features for a single Gmail users, such as website owners who answer many questions in their emails from customers, students, members, etc.

I have see how these other tools can modify the Gmail UI. We will also need to do that a little, but it shouldn't be anything crazy. Here are some of the ideas I am looking to achieve:

Status - The goal is to keep the inbox clean and only show messages that are open. Any messages that are considered completed will be marked as “Closed” which will archive the message, and it will no longer show in the inbox.
Response Status - It is important to know at a glance if a message requires my response, or if I have already sent a response and I am waiting on the other person to reply back to me. If I have not yet replied to a message, it will have a status badge of “Open” or “Awaiting Your Reply” something like that. If I have already replied to the message, but it is not yet closed/archived, then it will have a status badge of “Waiting On
Add new option to Send button for “Send And Mark Closed”

Timestamp - The Gmail list view does not show the date and time of the message. This is only seen when opening the message and clicking the more info dropdown. This is critical missing information. I need to be able to see the date and time of when the message arrived or of the last reply in the main list view. We can use a “time-ago” timestamp method to show how many days/hours/minutes ago was the last response.

Add ticket number - all incoming messages will get a number appended to it like #2734. This will be for internal view only, and will not be seen by contact.

Automatically mark messages as “Closed” that are waiting on a customer reply after (x) number of days of inactivity. If they reply, no worries - it will just open again.

Add new categories to the Gmail left sidebar to show messages by inbox. For example, I may have several email address aliases connected to one inbox. I would like to be able to click to see messages for each like [EMAIL], or [EMAIL], etc.

There could be more ideas, but these are the basics. In your application, I would like to hear your assessment of the feasibility of these features and give a natural indication to me that you have read and understood them by mentioning something about them as you explain what is possible.

title: Modify Gmail With Custom Chrome Extension - urgent
description:
There are many "shared inbox" tools out there for Gmail, such as Drag, Gmelius, Hiver, Keeping, etc. But I am looking to create a Chrome extension that adds some basic helpdesk features for a single Gmail users, such as website owners who answer many questions in their emails from customers, students, members, etc.

I have see how these other tools can modify the Gmail UI. We will also need to do that a little, but it shouldn't be anything crazy. Here are some of the ideas I am looking to achieve:

Status - The goal is to keep the inbox clean and only show messages that are open. Any messages that are considered completed will be marked as “Closed” which will archive the message, and it will no longer show in the inbox.
Response Status - It is important to know at a glance if a message requires my response, or if I have already sent a response and I am waiting on the other person to reply back to me. If I have not yet replied to a message, it will have a status badge of “Open” or “Awaiting Your Reply” something like that. If I have already replied to the message, but it is not yet closed/archived, then it will have a status badge of “Waiting On
Add new option to Send button for “Send And Mark Closed”

Timestamp - The Gmail list view does not show the date and time of the message. This is only seen when opening the message and clicking the more info dropdown. This is critical missing information. I need to be able to see the date and time of when the message arrived or of the last reply in the main list view. We can use a “time-ago” timestamp method to show how many days/hours/minutes ago was the last response.

Add ticket number - all incoming messages will get a number appended to it like #2734. This will be for internal view only, and will not be seen by contact.

Automatically mark messages as “Closed” that are waiting on a customer reply after (x) number of days of inactivity. If they reply, no worries - it will just open again.

Add new categories to the Gmail left sidebar to show messages by inbox. For example, I may have several email address aliases connected to one inbox. I would like to be able to click to see messages for each like [EMAIL], or [EMAIL], etc.

There could be more ideas, but these are the basics. In your application, I would like to hear your assessment of the feasibility of these features and give a natural indication to me that you have read and understood them by mentioning something about them as you explain what is possible.

title: Load Forecasting for Competitive Trading Bilateral Contract Market using Machine Learning
description: In vertically integrated power markets of Pakistan, forecasting electricity loads is one of the most essential tasks for system planning, operation and decision making. The accurate prediction of service demand is necessary to lay out optimized plans for the generation and distribution of power. In this context, load forecasting model is pertinent to power system of Pakistan. Electric load forecasting involves the projection of peak demand levels and overall energy consumption patterns to support an electricity company’s future system and business operations. The accurate prediction of both the load magnitude and geographical locations of electric load over the different time periods becomes. Short and mid-range predictions of power load allow electricity companies to retain high energy efficiency, reliable operation, and making optimized plan for power generation and distribution. Power system of Pakistan poses an eccentric problem, a decade ago generation resources were limited but now it has been engulfed by circular debt. There is a crisis of capacity payments in energy sector. The present generation has exceeded to the level that it will be sufficient for next decade but the transmission and distribution capacity is in dire need of upgradation. Therefore, the market model has started to shift towards wholesale model instead of present central system. Competitive Trading Bilateral Contract Market is the first step towards the liberal market. Keeping in mind the present dynamics, the short-term load forecasting will be of outmost importance. Therefore, foremost objective of this research is to empower Pakistan’s power system with accurate load forecasting tool, which will handle the times series as well as other major variables such as geography, weather and per capita income. The electricity load forecasting is a complex task due to the nature of load affecting variables. Dealing with abrupt changes in weather conditions and modeling consumer's usage behaviors is a challenging task. Machine learning based statistical and artificial intelligence techniques are widely used. Among these, artificial neural networks (ANN) and support vector machines (SVM) emerge as competitive modeling approaches. Still, appropriate selection of SVM and ANN parameters requires proper optimization techniques to avoid slow convergence, local minima, and over-cutting of models. Another challenge lies in the generalization of these models; none of the reported models so far, has attained a sturdy stature as a generally applicable technique. The modern optimization techniques are robust, less time-consuming, dependable, and provide high quality solutions for parameter selection and model development. The accuracy of modeling techniques is extremely dependent on quality of historical data. Since the recording of data in Pakistan power systems was mainly manual. This data contained abnormalities like missing values, outliers, and duplication of records. Observing all theaforementioned problems, we got motivation to devise such a model that can perform well on noisy data of Pakistan’s power systems. Hence, we plan to review and evaluate, an integrated and customized model for day ahead forecasting. The model under study is “Machine Learning based switching model.” This model utilizes two major machine learning techniques Bayesian Clustering by dynamics (BCD) and Support Vector Regression (SVR). The BCD classifier has been utilized to recognize the switching of the load series and segregation has been performed utilizing SVR. To overcome the short comings of historical data we included various components to the system, such as: pre-treatment of historical data, analysis, transformation, cross validation, and over-ratting modules. The pre-processing module deals with outliers, anomalies, resolving the missing data problems in load series, curve smoothing, and data normalization. The data was tested defined models on electric demand and load affecting parameters data collected from national and local distribution companies of Pakistan.

Email Delivery of Storybook: Upon completion, users will receive an email containing a URL to their personalized storybook hosted on a specific webpage, along with a downloadable PDF version. Re-Training Data based on Images Selected: Users who have selected individual images will create a re-training dataset that will let the model learn. description:
We need a new Android app created. It will be used by only by shopkeepers in physical shop premises so it would not be available for public use. The only people who could use the would be specifically invited by us. We DO NOT need an iOS version; it will be Android only.

In simple terms the app will let a Shopkeeper first scan a physical empty gift card. Loading this card with money is the whole purpose of the app. So next on our app we need to take payment from a customer for the amount they want to load. Once that money is taken successfully we call a 3rd party API which loads the gift card number that was scanned in at the start. That’s basically it so not hugely complicated.

We only want someone who has done this kind of thing before on Android apps. Please don’t waste our time if you are not an Android app expert and know all about how Near Field Communication (NFC) works with apps. We also need a rough idea of how many hours something like this would take and a fixed price quote if possible.

Here is a bit more information on the process:

1. The app will require the shopkeeper to login first. We will provide them with their username/password that we create on the admin side. There is no self-registration option.

2. To use the app the shopkeeper will first pick up a new blank gift card from their supply and scan it via Near Field Communication (NFC) on the device the app is installed on. We just need to know the card number in order to load it later if the rest of the transaction is successful.

3. We need an option to manually type in the gift card number too. Sometimes a shopkeeper might want to load multiple gift cards at the same time. We need a way for them to be able to scan them all first then pay in 1 transaction (assuming it's the same value for each card) or a way to manually enter a card number range as these will be sequential e.g. Gift cards might be XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX1, XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX2, XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX3 etc.

4. Next, the shopkeeper enters the value the customer wants to load on the gift card e.g. £50.

5. Then we need to process the payment. We want to use [URL] and integrate it into our app for this. We ideally want the customer to be able to touch their debit/credit card to the shopkeeper's android device to authorise the payment and let us take their money.

6. If, and only if, the payment transaction is successful we then call a separate existing 3rd party API to load the gift card with the same amount. We captured the gift card number as the first step so we pass this in the API and it's then all taken care of externally. We would just get a success or failure message back to show in the app. We will give docs on the API but we've used it before and it's quite straightforward.

7. The app must be super-robust with all errors handled. It can be very simple but must be user-friendly and idiot-proof for shopkeeper users.

8. We would provide all designs for the app screens. You just need to build it.

9. The app would need an admin interface for us to add in Countries, Cities, Shop, Shopkeeper users and see all transaction history. One shop could have multiple shopkeeper users.

title: Development of Android App that takes payments using NFC
description:
We need a new Android app created. It will be used by only by shopkeepers in physical shop premises so it would not be available for public use. The only people who could use the would be specifically invited by us. We DO NOT need an iOS version; it will be Android only.

In simple terms the app will let a Shopkeeper first scan a physical empty gift card. Loading this card with money is the whole purpose of the app. So next on our app we need to take payment from a customer for the amount they want to load. Once that money is taken successfully we call a 3rd party API which loads the gift card number that was scanned in at the start. That’s basically it so not hugely complicated.

We only want someone who has done this kind of thing before on Android apps. Please don’t waste our time if you are not an Android app expert and know all about how Near Field Communication (NFC) works with apps. We also need a rough idea of how many hours something like this would take and a fixed price quote if possible.

Here is a bit more information on the process:

1. The app will require the shopkeeper to login first. We will provide them with their username/password that we create on the admin side. There is no self-registration option.

2. To use the app the shopkeeper will first pick up a new blank gift card from their supply and scan it via Near Field Communication (NFC) on the device the app is installed on. We just need to know the card number in order to load it later if the rest of the transaction is successful.

3. We need an option to manually type in the gift card number too. Sometimes a shopkeeper might want to load multiple gift cards at the same time. We need a way for them to be able to scan them all first then pay in 1 transaction (assuming it's the same value for each card) or a way to manually enter a card number range as these will be sequential e.g. Gift cards might be XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX1, XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX2, XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX3 etc.

4. Next, the shopkeeper enters the value the customer wants to load on the gift card e.g. £50.

5. Then we need to process the payment. We want to use [URL] and integrate it into our app for this. We ideally want the customer to be able to touch their debit/credit card to the shopkeeper's android device to authorise the payment and let us take their money.

6. If, and only if, the payment transaction is successful we then call a separate existing 3rd party API to load the gift card with the same amount. We captured the gift card number as the first step so we pass this in the API and it's then all taken care of externally. We would just get a success or failure message back to show in the app. We will give docs on the API but we've used it before and it's quite straightforward.

7. The app must be super-robust with all errors handled. It can be very simple but must be user-friendly and idiot-proof for shopkeeper users.

8. We would provide all designs for the app screens. You just need to build it.

9. The app would need an admin interface for us to add in Countries, Cities, Shop, Shopkeeper users and see all transaction history. One shop could have multiple shopkeeper users.

Questions for you
Will a phone or tablet work on its own for reading in the gift card and taking payments from the customer's debit/credit card or would we need some extra hardware?

title: Digital Marketing: Google Analytics Analysis + Goal Setting / Forecasting
description:
We are a digital marketing agency looking for an analytics specialist who can analyze our clients' Google Analytics accounts and forecast goals based on historical data.
Our clients all utilize Google Analytics, so it is important you are extremely well-versed in that tool. We have high-level goals for each client like "Increase new user sign-ups on our website", but we are looking for someone to analyze historical YoY data to forecast what numerical goal we should be striving for over the next calendar year. For example: "Increase new user sign-ups from 12,125 last year to 15,832 this year" or "Increase MQLs 25% this year".
In some instances, the clients already have defined goals "increase revenue 50% this year", but we want you to analyze the data to validate whether or not that is an attainable goal, based on historical performance.
This is a critical project for our business. Please only apply if this is something you are EXTREMELY CONFIDENT in and have experience in doing this exact task.
duration: 3 to 6 months, Hours to be determined
screening_questions: How do you make sure your numbers match the finance team's numbers?
Describe a dashboard you built and the decision it supported.
Give an example of an analysis that changed what a client did.

title: AI Developer / Machine Learning (reposted)
description:
